description: This test ensures that the user can navigate to the privacy policy page from the footer and access the content.
steps: Scroll to the footer section of the page.
Locate the 'Privacy Policy' link using its stable selector.
Ensure that the privacy policy page loads successfully.
Verify the presence of key privacy policy sections.
expected_results: User is redirected to the privacy policy page.
Privacy policy page loads without errors.
Key privacy policy sections are accessible and visible.
edge_cases: Privacy policy page fails to load.
Slow page load due to large content.
data_requirements: Valid URL for the privacy policy page.
dependencies: Footer link must be present on the landing page.
Privacy policy page must be live and operational.
performance_metrics: Page load time for the privacy policy page.
accessibility_requirements: Footer links should be keyboard accessible.
Privacy policy page should support screen readers.
